events.title: Athenae Initiative Launch
events.summary:
On August 27th, Athenae Initiative gathered at Bar Milton-Parc for our official launch; it was an evening filled with great conversation, new connections, and most importantly, a shared appreciation for the humanities.

Thank to our supporters, we raised over $500 through our 50/50 raffle tickets, which was an amazing way to kick off Athenae's fundraising efforts.
